system.name: Parcae
system.one_liner: a proactive, liveput-optimized DNN training system for preemptible spot instances

components.name: DNN Model
components.role: the model a user submits as a training job

components.name: ParcaeScheduler
components.role: runs persistently on one on-demand CPU instance; determines the migration schedule and manages training data samples

components.name: Migration Manager
components.role: determines the migration schedule based on the liveput optimizer and availability predictor

components.name: Liveput Optimizer
components.role: computes proactive reconfiguration decisions to optimize liveput

components.name: Sample Manager
components.role: manages the training data samples to maintain training semantics, exchanging sample ids with agents

components.name: ParcaeAgent
components.role: runs on each spot GPU instance; performs the assigned training workload, monitors training progress, and executes migration strategies issued by the scheduler

components.name: ParcaePS
components.role: runs on several on-demand CPU instances to keep model checkpoints for rare rollback cases

components.name: Parameter Server
components.role: stores and updates model parameters from gradients

content.key_idea: Parcae consists of three main components: a persistent ParcaeScheduler on an on-demand CPU instance that computes migration schedules via a liveput optimizer and availability predictor, ParcaeAgents on each spot GPU instance that train and execute migrations, and a ParcaePS holding checkpoints on on-demand CPU instances for rare rollbacks.
content.reading_order: top-down: user submits a job through the cloud provider's spot service, into ParcaeScheduler which coordinates two ParcaeAgent instances below it, which in turn connect down to the ParcaePS parameter servers.

summary: Parcae is a system for DNN training on preemptible (spot) cloud instances that proactively reconfigures training to maximize liveput. Figure 7 gives a whole-system overview, stacked top-down: a user submits a DNN model as a job through a cloud provider's Spot Service, which can gain or lose instances. Below, a green-shaded ParcaeScheduler box, running persistently on an on-demand CPU instance, contains a Migration Manager combining a Liveput Optimizer and an Availability Predictor to determine the migration schedule, plus a Sample Manager that manages training data samples to preserve training semantics. It issues migration instructions down to two pink-shaded ParcaeAgent boxes, each running on a spot GPU instance, performing the assigned training workload, monitoring progress, and executing the scheduler's migration strategies while syncing with its peer. The agents send gradients down to a ParcaePS box holding multiple Parameter Server instances on on-demand CPU instances, which keeps model checkpoints for rare rollback cases and returns model states.
summary_zh: 该图展示Parcae系统架构：作业经云端Spot服务提交后，运行在按需CPU实例上的ParcaeScheduler（含迁移管理器与样本管理器）依据liveput优化器和可用性预测器调度Spot GPU实例上的ParcaeAgent进行训练，并与保存模型检查点的ParcaePS交换梯度与模型状态。
